motivation: GPT-2 CPU 0.10 results motivated these rules. This is not a blinded discovery rule; retrospective application is exploratory and held-out application must be reported separately.

bisect.metric: median log2(candidate compiled RMSE / fixed baseline compiled RMSE) over paired gradient targets with finite, strictly positive fp64 errors
bisect.classification: All three scores at or above threshold: shifted; all below: not shifted; mixed scores or unavailable evidence: inconclusive. No primary verdict is changed.
bisect.reference: Per-target median of three fresh 2.15.0 CPU observations; target identities and workload/settings fixed before searching dates.
bisect.scope: A binary search assumes a monotone transition over available nightly builds. Report tested dates, absent builds, neighbor confirmations, and the upstream SHA interval; do not infer a specific commit without additional evidence.

accuracy_shift.scope: All output/gradient value targets with fp64 evidence, independently of primary tolerance failures; registered-state and post-call-input checks excluded.
accuracy_shift.coverage_denominator: Union of output/gradient value targets observed in the primary comparison in either environment.
accuracy_shift.ties: Equal errors count as zero growth and are excluded only from the sign-test trials.
accuracy_shift.zeros: Both exact: zero log growth and a tie; newly nonzero: positive infinity; newly exact: negative infinity. Extended values use explicit JSON statuses, never nonfinite JSON numbers.
accuracy_shift.missing: Missing, nonfinite, non-fp64, or failed reference evidence remains in coverage denominators and cannot count as agreement.
accuracy_shift.statistics: Target errors are correlated; the sign-test p-value is descriptive, not a calibrated model-level probability or proof of a defect. Report all pair values and counts, not just flags.
accuracy_shift.validation: Retrospective application to the 40 original 0.10 pairs is exploratory. Mark held-out validation only after applying these unchanged thresholds to new model sweeps.

noise_floor.formula: max(eager_vs_fp64_rmse, eager_control_vs_fp64_rmse when available, c * 2^-24 * RMS(fp64_reference))
noise_floor.scope: Advisory comparability, same-input backward checks, and contrary evidence only. Keep all original error/ratio fields and all primary comparison policies.
noise_floor.control: Use an eager control measured against the same fp64 reference; never substitute control-versus-eager RMSE. Unsupported or absent controls are explicitly omitted from the max and recorded.
noise_floor.rationale: A fixed 32-unit-roundoff scale term prevents a nearly exact eager reference from being the sole denominator. It is an engineering floor, not a rigorous operation-count error bound or an estimate fitted to these models.

preservation: 0.10 data, primary statuses, tolerances, failure signatures, reducer predicates, and existing command exit codes remain unchanged. No upstream issue is filed automatically.
